_dylxnwxlker_: The sergeant gave Henrik Dylxnwxlker a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 16 or any other.
ancient_space_man: Arno Man arrived at P-F5 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.

Arno Man and Pavel Photography carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached P-F5 with the rations. Arno Man ate while listening to the revised orders.
A letter reached Arno Man from Lindenbruck. The streets there still have names. He read them out loud, one by one.
Arno Man drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty.
Wiring party. Arno Man held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at P-F5, and everyone came back.
A patient apologized for bleeding on Arno Man's sleeve. He told the patient to concentrate on staying awake.

In the dark of the Hegemony trench Arno Man hit Lucien Hateley with a trench club, then ran for the wire before the flares went up. (@leighton_hateley) Arno Man jumped into the Hegemony trench and swung the shovel at the first shape that moved. It was Roland Gdot. The Hegemony medics will be busy. (@gdot08) Arno Man went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits.
astra_bd: By the time Otto "Rabbit" Astra reached U-F9, the war was 10 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

Otto "Rabbit" Astra was hit in the hand while passing a mug along the trench at U-F9. He did not spill a drop. The men are still talking about that. Shot by Leopold "Tin" Guy of the Concord (@siddharth_guy). Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Otto "Rabbit" Astra shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Otto "Rabbit" Astra walked back up the communication trench to U-F9, slower than before, but on his own feet.
Leopold Zushinku pulled Otto "Rabbit" Astra out of a flooded shell hole at the Brickworks. Neither has mentioned it since. Both remember.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Otto "Rabbit" Astra lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
Leopold Zushinku and Otto "Rabbit" Astra made a pact: whoever gets home first visits the other's mother. They shook on it twice, to be sure.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Otto "Rabbit" Astra pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
benryderfitz: "You're late," said the corporal when Otto Benryderfitz arrived on Day 10. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Bram Des and Otto Benryderfitz spent an hour hunting rats with a bucket and a piece of cheese. Score at dusk: rats 4, soldiers 1. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Otto Benryderfitz read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Otto Benryderfitz woke with his hair frozen to the sandbags. The cook brought tea so hot it hurt. Nobody complained.
Otto Benryderfitz owes Pavel Jit so many cigarettes that they stopped counting and started writing it down. The notebook is nearly full.
Nils Tuj snores. Otto Benryderfitz does not. Otto now sleeps with a sock stuffed in each ear, and the two are still friends.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Otto Benryderfitz. The men named it Old Tom and said it had chosen him.
An empty jam tin became Otto Benryderfitz's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.
broadshoulderedbastard: Hugo "Lucky" Broadshoulde came up the line with a photograph gone soft at the edges and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Hugo "Lucky" Broadshoulde began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.

A shell landed square in S-F20. They found Hugo "Lucky" Broadshoulde alive under the sandbags, barely. Every minute counts now. Hugo "Lucky" Broadshoulde died at his post at S-F20 when the dugout roof came down under a direct hit.

Rafael Broadshoulde came to the front because his uncle Hugo "Lucky" Broadshoulde never came home. He carries a photograph gone soft at the edges. Hill 304 has been won. Rafael Broadshoulde listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Rafael Broadshoulde checked every ammunition belt by lamplight. One bad cartridge was enough to make him start the whole inspection again.
On sentry duty Rafael Broadshoulde watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.

Rafael Broadshoulde had kept the gun aimed at the enemy supply path for days. Tonight the supply party came, and Hugo Kitty was grazed. A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Rafael Broadshoulde across the shin at S-F20. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Isidor Jacksondeehr of the Concord (@jacksondeehring).
Rafael Broadshoulde is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Rafael Broadshoulde was hit hard in the fight at S-F20 before anyone could fire. The raider was Gideon Mirwik of the Concord. Raider: Gideon Mirwik of the Concord (@_mirwik_). Rafael Broadshoulde threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Severin Guy was down and screaming for a medic. (@hi.its.guy) The Concord raiders were in and out in two minutes. At S-F20 they left Rafael Broadshoulde behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Norbert Seamus of the Concord (@seamus_bj).
Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde put a photograph gone soft at the edges beside the bunk. Someone who had known Rafael Broadshoulde helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde wrote the range on the back of a ration card: 380 yards. Then Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde used it. Florian Streekluukva was gravely wounded. Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Gideon Sam was badly wounded. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde is number 280. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.

Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Tobias Cpurvis crossed it, Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde fired. Tobias Cpurvis was gravely wounded. Dawn watch. Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Yann Rattamus, grazed.

A bullet clipped Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde's helmet at S-F20 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Felix "Button" White of the Concord (@harry_white_y).
Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde saw a hare run the whole length of no man's land and nobody on either side fired at it.
Rain washed the chalk names from the trench signs. Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde spent the evening directing strangers past the same junction.
chelsea.deakins: Day 11: Anselm Deakins reached V-F6 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Anselm Deakins looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Anselm Deakins opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
Asked what he will do after the war, Anselm Deakins said: 'Be a tailor in Halden. And never complain about anything, ever again.'
The east wind brought the smell of the other trenches: smoke, lime and somebody's cooking. Anselm Deakins was hungry and furious about it.
A bullet clipped Anselm Deakins's helmet at V-F6 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Ulrich "Parson" Philnowak of the Hegemony (@philnowak).
Anselm Deakins rejoined the squad at V-F6. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
damocles4152: After 10 days of war, T-F2 had a place for everything. On Day 10, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Jakub Damocles.

Jakub Damocles put an empty tin under a short table leg. Supper stopped sliding toward the corporal. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Jakub Damocles folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
A child had slipped a riddle into a parcel for Jakub Damocles. He kept the dugout guessing until supper, then turned the page over and read the answer.
Jakub Damocles of the Hegemony spotted Bram Jimbeachball of the Concord repairing a parapet at Sorrow Copse. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.
Rafael "Brick" Firekeyboard (Concord) and Jakub Damocles (Hegemony) came to the same broken well at the Hanging Bridge at night, each with a bucket. They filled them in turns and backed away.
Jakub Damocles kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.
A recruit asked Jakub Damocles how to write an address. He brought paper and began with the largest letters on a ration label.
douglas_traill: "You're late," said the corporal when Isidor Traill arrived on Day 12. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
The corporal found out Isidor Traill used to be a choir singer. Isidor Traill has been doing two jobs ever since.
Isidor Traill went out with the wiring party at N-F10. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit.
The listening post reported scraping beyond the wire. Isidor Traill waited through an hour of it before a loose stake was found.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Isidor Traill's ear at N-F10 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Dorian "Mud" Prime of the Concord (@xerod.prime).
ethanbay_23: Wendel "Parson" Ethanbay arrived with the evening ration party, carrying his mother's thimble and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

A shell landed square in S-S9. They found Wendel "Parson" Ethanbay alive under the sandbags, barely. Every minute counts now. Wendel "Parson" Ethanbay was killed outright by a direct hit at S-S9. The men dug for an hour and found only his identity disc.

The House of Ethanbay sent another. Hugo "Button" Ethanbay, older brother of Wendel "Parson" Ethanbay, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence. Day 6. The Hegemony took Hill 304. From the heights Hugo "Button" Ethanbay could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Shellfire stopped the carrying party at a trench junction. Hugo "Button" Ethanbay waited under a load that got heavier by the minute.
The promotion to Lance Corporal reached Hugo "Button" Ethanbay on a creased slip of paper. He smoothed it and put it with the letters from home.
Hugo "Button" Ethanbay was promised a surprise at supper. It was an extra potato. He accepted the surprise with proper ceremony.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Hugo "Button" Ethanbay's bunk. He has named it Margarethe.
The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-S9 changed before the cheering ended. Hugo "Button" Ethanbay shouldered another load.

Margarethe the rat now waits for Hugo "Button" Ethanbay at dawn watch every morning. He shares crumbs with it. The corporal calls this desertion of rations. Hugo "Button" Ethanbay got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 363. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Hugo "Button" Ethanbay watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.
Hugo "Button" Ethanbay carried duckboards up from the rear all night. His shoulders are a map of splinters.
Margarethe ran squealing out of the dugout at three in the morning. Hugo "Button" Ethanbay followed, cursing, seconds before a shell came through the roof. He owes Margarethe his life.
Hugo "Button" Ethanbay sharpened a pencil carefully and then could not think what to write. He put the date at the top anyway.
Hugo "Button" Ethanbay was promoted to Corporal. The first request addressed to the new rank concerned a blocked drain.

Hugo "Button" Ethanbay was carrying water up to S-S9 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Hugo "Button" Ethanbay did not. Shot by Marek "Doc" Dizickkumer of the Concord (@dizickkumer). Outside the aid post, Hugo "Button" Ethanbay lies on a stretcher among the others. The orderlies step over him and say soon.
grif.fith117: The sergeant gave Roland "Shadow" Fith a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 12 or any other.
A bullet clipped Roland "Shadow" Fith's helmet at V-F11 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Yann Operatortex of the Concord (@operatortex145).
Roland "Shadow" Fith's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Roland "Shadow" Fith. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Roland "Shadow" Fith was hit hard in the fight at V-F11 before anyone could fire. The raider was Matthias Yoboiwhitech of the Concord. Raider: Matthias Yoboiwhitech of the Concord (@yoboiwhitecheddar).
josh.wamble: Bastian "Parson" Wamble unpacked a tin whistle at Q-F9. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.

Bastian "Parson" Wamble let three easy targets go by. The fourth was the one worth the risk. Severin Xavierzane was badly wounded. Face blackened with soot, Bastian "Parson" Wamble spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Dorian "Lucky" Raptor was gravely wounded. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Bastian "Parson" Wamble did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Bastian "Parson" Wamble has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.
Bastian "Parson" Wamble wrote the range on the back of a ration card: 380 yards. Then Bastian "Parson" Wamble used it. Emil "Doc" Xavierzane was gravely wounded.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Bastian "Parson" Wamble reached up to fix a sandbag at Q-F9 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway.

A bullet struck Bastian "Parson" Wamble below the ribs at Q-F9. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue of the Concord (@grebegue).
Bastian "Parson" Wamble lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
joshaaguayo89: Karel Joshaaguayo arrived with the Day 13 draft, carrying a cracked shaving mirror and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
The bread was divided with a ruler. Karel Joshaaguayo received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler.
Karel Joshaaguayo checked the duty roster and noticed the same names on the worst shifts. He fetched a fresh sheet of paper and started over.
Karel Joshaaguayo brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.
luckystrike_148: The new stretcher bearer is Hugo Luckystrike, once a tailor from Coldwater. The corporal asked if a tailor was any use in a trench. Hugo Luckystrike said he would find out.
Silas Pope (Concord) threw a loaf of bread into the Hegemony trench at Grey Mill. An hour later a sausage came back with a note from Hugo Luckystrike: 'Fair trade.'

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Hugo Luckystrike was hit hard in the fight at V-F8 before anyone could fire. The raider was Edmund "Parson" Akauncletom of the Concord. Raider: Edmund "Parson" Akauncletom of the Concord (@akauncletom).
metropolitan_wr: They issued Clement Metropolitan a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a cracked shaving mirror in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.
The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Clement Metropolitan read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.

A dummy head on a stick drew the enemy's eye at R-R16. Clement Metropolitan saw where the answering shot came from and fired back. Isidor "Ghost" Carnahanwile was gravely wounded. A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Clement Metropolitan across the shin at R-R16. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Bastian "Mud" Hi of the Hegemony (@hi691812). The clerk counted the names twice. Clement Metropolitan is number 969 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Clement Metropolitan watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.

Clement Metropolitan was carrying water up to R-R16 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Clement Metropolitan did not. Shot by Gideon Alt of the Hegemony (@just.luke.alt). Clement Metropolitan stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-R16. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Gideon Alt of the Hegemony (@just.luke.alt).
A letter came with Walter Metropolitan: "I am Clement Metropolitan's cousin. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
Face blackened with soot, Walter Metropolitan spent the night in a shell hole out in front of the wire. At first light Jonas "Doc" Angelogia was badly wounded.
A man asked Walter Metropolitan to describe Tannenfeld without mentioning the weather. He began with the steepest street and ended with the cheapest lunch.
A round went through Walter Metropolitan's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Ivo Hohne of the Hegemony (@shawn_hohne).
A bullet struck Walter Metropolitan below the ribs at R-R16. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Zeno Cdub of the Hegemony (@cdub_b1).
moist_breadcrumb: Clement Breadcrumb, a schoolteacher from Greyhallow, was sent forward on Day 6 to fill a gap in R-S6. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Marek "Smokes" Mod and Clement Breadcrumb carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle.
Tobias Deadeyesimul (Hegemony) watched Clement Breadcrumb (Concord) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at the Drowned Farm, and held fire until both were gone.
Clement Breadcrumb spent the night underground, listening. Somewhere beneath Calvary Farm someone else was digging too.

Clement Breadcrumb went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits. From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Clement Breadcrumb wrote to an old father who runs the family shop alone that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

Clement Breadcrumb lent Norbert Bucket a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'. Clement Breadcrumb got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 463. The men who came later will ask about it. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Clement Breadcrumb looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Clement Breadcrumb saw Norbert Bucket freeze up on the fire step at Blackwater Canal. Clement said nothing, just stood closer. It was enough.
The corporal found out Clement Breadcrumb used to be a schoolteacher. Clement Breadcrumb has been doing two jobs ever since.
Clement Breadcrumb went out with the wiring party at N-F13. Crawl, hammer a stake, pull the wire, crawl back. Nobody was hit.
A bullet went through Clement Breadcrumb's sleeve at R-S6 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Otto Tyner of the Hegemony (@tyner_1776).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Clement Breadcrumb is whole again, or near enough for the line.
noah.thomsen.77: On Day 14, Florian Thomsen arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
Florian Thomsen's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
Florian Thomsen lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified.
paulgavin829: The quartermaster asked Hugo Paulgavin to sign for the blanket. He examined the blanket and asked whether the holes were included.
A bullet grazed Hugo Paulgavin's ribs at U-F21. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Teodor "Parson" Kobakk of the Concord (@kobakk2).

The medics cleaned Hugo Paulgavin's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at U-F21. A letter from home found Hugo Paulgavin before the night shift. Hugo Paulgavin folded it small and kept it close.

Ulrich Maliklee drew a map of Hugo Paulgavin's hometown from Hugo's stories. Hugo says it is wrong in every detail, and carries it everywhere. A letter from home found Hugo Paulgavin before the night shift. Hugo Paulgavin folded it small and kept it close.

Hugo Paulgavin was hit in the hip at U-F21. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Arno "Whistle" Oli of the Concord (@oli.c.h_1944). A letter from home found Hugo Paulgavin before the night shift. Hugo Paulgavin folded it small and kept it close.

No bed for Hugo Paulgavin yet. A medic checked the bandage and promised him a place as soon as one opened up. A letter came for Hugo Paulgavin with a ribbon tied around it. Hugo Paulgavin kept the ribbon in a tunic pocket.
penigorouspen: Ivo Penigorouspe came up the line with a key to a house that is no longer there and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Ivo Penigorouspe stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Ivo Penigorouspe spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Ivo Penigorouspe is number 752. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. After the loss of Grey Mill, Ivo Penigorouspe helped stack spare sandbags at S-C2. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Ivo Penigorouspe spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.
The section held a competition for the worst joke. Ivo Penigorouspe won before reaching the end of his entry.
Ivo Penigorouspe brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.

Ivo Penigorouspe took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at S-C2, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Arno Zag of the Hegemony (@grz_zag420).

Ivo Penigorouspe's wound turned bad. The bandage was not enough and he was carried back to wait for a bed. The orderlies scrubbed a bed in the hospital dugout and called for Ivo Penigorouspe. He was asleep before they set him down.
porsche930tt: Ulrich Porsche arrived with the Day 9 draft, carrying a pack of cards missing the queen of hearts and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Ulrich Porsche wrote to five brothers, all on other fronts that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

A bullet hit Ulrich Porsche's belt buckle at R-R4 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Emil Painter of the Hegemony (@neophyte_painter). Ulrich Porsche had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Emil Pastaeaterxa was badly wounded. The clerk counted the names twice. Ulrich Porsche is number 929 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. After the loss of Grey Mill, Ulrich Porsche helped stack spare sandbags at R-R4. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
The medics cleaned Ulrich Porsche's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at R-R4.
Ulrich Porsche offered a biscuit for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at R-R4 and grazed Ulrich Porsche's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Walter "Hollow" Malakaicripp of the Hegemony (@malakaicripps). Ulrich Porsche rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Albin Icespiceynod was grazed at the far edge of no man's land.
Ulrich Porsche was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-R4. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Dorian Hensley of the Hegemony (@christian.__.hensley).
The medics had to choose who got the last bed. They did not choose Ulrich Porsche. He died on the stretcher before morning.
The papers connected Leopold Porsche to Ulrich Porsche. The men took longer to learn Leopold Porsche's own habits, but they made the effort.
summacon1: The draft reached S-R2 on Day 9. Otto Summacon was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Otto Summacon looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

A bullet grazed Otto Summacon's ribs at S-R2. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Dietrich "Button" Slade of the Hegemony (@slade_2233). The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Otto Summacon answered to number 998. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Otto Summacon wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Otto Summacon no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
A replacement turned out to be from Wyvern Cross too. Otto Summacon and the newcomer argued about the same bakery for half the night.
The wind carried away the last words of every order. Otto Summacon waited until the corporal came closer before picking up anything heavy.

A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Otto Summacon shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Roland "Ghost" Idiot, was grazed. Otto Summacon raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-R2. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Arno Zag of the Hegemony (@grz_zag420).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Otto Summacon is whole again, or near enough for the line.
the_knight_of_reikland: Jakub "Spark" Reikland, a stonemason from Dunmarrow, was sent forward on Day 10 to fill a gap in T-F21. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

Jakub "Spark" Reikland heard a man laugh on the other side of the enemy parapet. It sounded so ordinary that it was more unsettling than a shot. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at T-F21 changed before the cheering ended. Jakub "Spark" Reikland shouldered another load.
Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher taught Jakub "Spark" Reikland three words in the language of home. Spark uses all three at the wrong moment, every day.
The company barber offered a choice of haircuts. Jakub "Spark" Reikland asked to see the second one. The barber laughed.
The corporal found out Jakub "Spark" Reikland used to be a stonemason. Jakub "Spark" Reikland has been doing two jobs ever since.
A clear shot from T-F21. Jakub "Spark" Reikland badly wounded Oskar Can and slid back down below the parapet.
Jakub "Spark" Reikland found a blank menu card and wrote the evening ration on it in elaborate handwriting. The bread became 'Bread, in the Army Manner'.
zczc1317: Nils Zczc left a girl from the dance hall, maybe behind in Millbank and came up the line with a bullet that missed him. The men noticed at once that he never sits with his back to the parapet.
The colonel shook hands with the first hundred, one by one. Nils Zczc was number 91. He still remembers how cold the colonel's glove was.
Day 3. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. From the heights Nils Zczc could see the whole Hegemony line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
A bullet went through Nils Zczc's sleeve at S-F9 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Cyril Mateorekon of the Hegemony (@mateorekon).
Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Nils Zczc is whole again, or near enough for the line.

Nils Zczc lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Nils Zczc kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Nils Zczc. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.
Edmund "Smokes" Rry taught Nils Zczc to play the harmonica. The whole squad has asked them both, politely, to stop.
The cook borrowed Nils Zczc's mug to measure flour. Getting it back involved waiting for the dough, the baking and the cook's memory.
Nils Zczc delivered an urgent message and waited while the officer searched every pocket for a pencil to sign for it.

At S-F9 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Nils Zczc turned around and took a shovel blow. Gideon Jimmysparrow of the Hegemony was already gone. Raider: Gideon Jimmysparrow of the Hegemony (@jimmysparrow17). After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Nils Zczc helped stack spare sandbags at S-F9. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Nils Zczc no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Nils Zczc watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Nils Zczc lent Roland Rry a pencil. It came back wrapped in a scrap of paper that said 'One good turn'.
Nils Zczc lost at cards to the corporal and now owes him a week of tobacco and one favour, unspecified.
Nils Zczc caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again.
